name: SnapTrade
description: SnapTrade lets agents read balances, positions, orders, and account activity from the brokerage accounts that the signed-in user connects to SnapTrade. This server is read-only and cannot place trades.

prompts.text: Summarize my positions across all my connected brokerage accounts.
How much cash is in each of my brokerage accounts?
What dividends did I receive last month?

apps.name: SnapTrade
apps.description: Balances, positions, orders, and activity, over SnapTrade's MCP server with browser sign-in.
